correctness.rationale: Binary cubics span all evaluations on the three rational P^1 points, so the tensor evaluation is onto dimension nine and the all-ones fiber has 128 masks. In independent replay (python3 /workspace/checks/check124.py, record 2), all 128 masks were first partitioned by direct action of all 72 ambient transformations, rather than generator closure on a prefiltered set. A four-chart Jacobian ideal check in grevlex over F2 on each orbit representative determined geometric smoothness; by the Nullstellensatz a proper ideal on any chart gives a geometric singularity. The accepted union matched every one of the 84 frozen masks; sizes and stabilizers were b0bd: 24 and 3, b0db: 24 and 3, b1cb: 36 and 2. Independent finite-field arithmetic, using alternate defining polynomials in degrees three and four, gave exactly (0,2,18,18), (0,0,18,12), (0,2,21,26). A smooth ample (3,3) divisor is geometrically connected. Adjunction gives its canonical bundle O(1,1)|C; the four ambient Segre sections form the full canonical linear system, and the containing quadric is unique because H^0(Q,O(-1,-1))=0. Thus the ambient orbits are abstract F2-isomorphism classes and the stabilizers are the F2-rational automorphism groups, not claims about automorphism group sizes over the algebraic closure. The bounded C singularity search is not required for this proof.

originality.rationale: Xarles's prior exhaustive genus-four census and its documented equation and point-count tables cover the main classification. The condition is a direct selection by the recorded split quadric and N[1]=0, not a new orbit classification or an application of an existence theorem. The displayed section masks use different coordinates, and the exact fixed-coordinate orbit weights are not stated in the passages inspected; once the prior classes are known, those weights are the sizes of their finite ambient orbits in the Segre coordinates. This is demonstrated broader database coverage rather than a verdict based on possible inaccessible overlap.
residual_risks: Exact mask-by-mask conversion from the published cubics and a source statement of the stabilizer orders were not checked. The originality decision concerns the verified coverage by the original complete equation census and its point-count index, not priority of literal hexadecimal masks or orbit-size typography.

value.rationale: The split bi-trigonal locus and absence of rational points are natural questions. Here the classes and extension fingerprints are a mechanical extraction from a published complete database of the same objects with the necessary fields. The added fixed-coordinate counts are small finite group actions on the extracted equations, without a separate unresolved structural or arithmetic question for which those particular counts are needed. The replay is a useful cross-check, not a distinct valuable result at the stated scope.
